title: Text-to-SQL Interface with Guardrails and Hallucination Detection
summary: Private local-first analyst console that demonstrates deterministic text-to-SQL validation and an approval-gated synthetic-data snapshot workflow.
outcome: Supported questions return transparent trusted verdicts; unsupported, malformed, unsafe, and hallucinated schema references are refused before execution.

deployment.runtime: FastAPI with read-only local DuckDB snapshot or explicit demo-fixture fallback

metrics: 100% execution accuracy across 4 expected trusted local evaluation cases
100% hallucination-detection rate across unknown-table and unknown-column cases
evaluation: Committed local evaluation report generated from the synthetic fixture
operationalTradeoffs: Exact-match catalog favors predictable safety over flexible language coverage
Azure Bicep is future, non-applied infrastructure only
disclaimer: Uses a hand-authored synthetic demo fixture only; not real bank or cardholder data, not deployed, and not production-ready.

story.executiveSummary: A transparent, bounded text-to-SQL guardrails demonstration with measured local safety behavior.
story.intendedUser: An analyst reviewing a constrained payments-data workflow.

example.title: Representative workflow
steps: Ask an exact supported payments question
Inspect generated SQL, validation checks, and a preview
See unsupported or unsafe requests refused

technologyDecisions.rationale: Makes supported behavior and pre-execution SQL policy testable locally.

limitations: Exact catalog matching only; unsupported questions are refused.
No full-source snapshot is committed; source hashes require owner verification before fetch.
Local synthetic fixture only; no real financial data.
No Azure resources are provisioned or deployed.
